required_change: Wrap each direct CDP checkpoint command in a tiny logger that records command id, method, repeat index, sample index/window id, parameters fingerprint, start/end driver monotonic timestamps, result/error, execution context, and object id/group where present.
first_validation: Trace-off raw-CDP wait, Runtime.evaluate x0/x1/x7/x17, Runtime.callFunctionOn x0/x1/x7/x17, and trace-off page.evaluate rows produce the expected command counts without changing retained p50 class ordering.
stop_condition: Stop before runtime tracing if logging changes the wait/checkpoint ordering or drops commands under repeat load.

source_surface: runStartedAtBrowserNowMs/runStoppedAtBrowserNowMs plus the proposed protocol command log
required_change: Record browser performance.now() sync points before and after each run, driver monotonic timestamps for every command, browser revision, and trace timebase metadata when tracing is later enabled.
first_validation: Every command window can be mapped into the previous-keyup-to-next-keydown gap without negative durations or ambiguous window assignment.
stop_condition: Stop if short repeat loops cannot be aligned to the same browser key-gap timebase used by EventDispatch.

required_change: Assign a stable runtimeCheckpointWindowId to the inter-key gap after sample i, mark retained/throwaway status, and join protocol commands, EventDispatch, observed gap, delay mode, repeat count, and source-span ids to that window.
first_validation: The extractor emits one row per retained key window plus command-count summaries; sample indices match existing latency rows exactly.
stop_condition: Stop if command windows can only be joined by aggregate run or if retained/throwaway indexing disagrees with existing records.

required_change: Append protocolCommandEvents to raw JSON and add a sidecar extractor that keeps per-command rows and per-window summaries without changing existing curated q50 output.
first_validation: Existing runtime-repeat summaries remain byte-for-byte equivalent for latency fields, while the new CSV exposes command ids, counts, durations, contexts, and window joins.
stop_condition: Stop if adding sidecar rows changes the reporter's existing latency output or forces a new metric definition.

source_surface: runtime repeat run manifest and current cdp-boundary summaries
required_change: Run the sidecar with tracing off first: x0/x1/x3/x7/x17 for Runtime.evaluate and Runtime.callFunctionOn, ordinary waits, and trace-off page.evaluate.
first_validation: Class ordering survives, command-count/duration scales with repeat count, no retained command windows are missing, and sidecar overhead is bounded by matched no-sidecar rows.
stop_condition: Do not enable scheduler/V8 categories until the protocol-only observer passes.

required_change: Only after the trace-off sidecar passes, add an opt-in browser trace bundle for task queues, scheduler/input priority, V8 execution, microtask checkpoints if exposed, process/thread ids, and flow ids; record the exact category list in artifacts.
first_validation: A per-window trace-state metric separates waits from runtime-repeat rows and tracks the x0/x1/x3/x7/x17 dose response while protocol-only ordering remains intact.
stop_condition: Reject named V8/scheduler/input-priority mechanisms if trace categories perturb ordering or fail to expose a state variable tied to retained key windows.

source_surface: trace-on keyboard/page.evaluate rows plus external protocol log
required_change: Use the sidecar or a separate low-overhead protocol log to record captureSnapshot/DOMSnapshot command windows for trace-on rows, without relying on Playwright tracing as the only observer.
first_validation: Trace-on fast rows align with snapshot protocol windows and share the same runtime/scheduler state as high-repeat trace-off runtime checkpoints.
stop_condition: Do not generalize the trace-on fast band if the observer itself creates the state or if snapshot command windows are not joined to retained keys.

source_surface: CPU/QoS sidecar; native runtime-repeat rows; Gutenberg source-span ids
required_change: Add renderer pid/thread ids, optional OS-counter sample ids, native scenario ids, Gutenberg fixture/source-span ids, and collector metadata after browser-side command and trace joins are stable.
first_validation: Browser state remains predictive after matching OS counters, and native rows show only browser-scale movement while Gutenberg source spans explain amplification.
stop_condition: Keep the exact mechanism at OS/QoS or workload scope if browser trace state does not survive these joins.
